purpose: Adds JSDoc annotations across the codebase to fix the CI 'Verify Docstring Coverage' failure. Covers lib/ (platform adapters, types, review-body helpers), action/ (self-heal workflow), and downgrades two eslint rules from error to warn.
riskRationale: Documentation-only changes; no logic modifications, no new dependencies, no behavioral impact. Eslint rule downgrade is a pragmatic trade-off that surfaces missing descriptions as warnings instead of blocking CI.

text: The PR addresses the docstring CI failure by adding JSDoc across ~35 files. Changes to adapter.ts (PlatformAdapter interface), github.ts, types/index.ts, review-body.ts, and self-heal.ts are well-structured with meaningful descriptions. However, gitlab-adapter.ts has systemic quality issues: ~30 methods use placeholder @returns ('Description.') and tautological @param descriptions ('X argument.'), and the constructor includes an invalid @returns tag. The .d.ts build artifacts also received JSDoc that will be lost on rebuild.

reasoning: GitLab adapter JSDoc is largely boilerplate placeholder text that passes the linter but provides no value to developers, which will accumulate technical debt. All issues are straightforward documentation fixes safe for automated application.

message: Well-structured JSDoc on every PlatformAdapter method with accurate, non-redundant @param and @returns descriptions. Serves as the reference pattern for the codebase.
Clear multi-paragraph JSDoc describing the Detect→Diagnose→Fix→Verify→Learn pipeline, with proper doc blocks on private helpers.

Downgrading require-param-description and require-returns-description to warn is pragmatic — param/return presence is still enforced at error level, while missing descriptions surface without blocking CI.
Well-structured JSDoc for GitHub adapter alias methods and getCurrentUser with clear parameter descriptions, return docs, and edge-case notes.
updateMR JSDoc properly documents the nested updates.title and updates.body parameters.
Clean, single-line JSDoc for the Platform type export.
Accurate and sufficient JSDoc for buildReviewBody — concise summary with correctly typed @param and @returns.
JSDoc correctly documents optional confidence parameter and emoji return type, matching the function signature.
Minimal, targeted diff — only missing JSDoc blocks added without unrelated changes or refactoring.
Constructor JSDoc has @returns Description. — constructors do not return values. Also @param token, @param repo, and @param apiUrl lack meaningful descriptions.
suggestion: Remove @returns from constructor JSDoc and add meaningful parameter descriptions.
suggestionCode:
/**
   * Constructor.
   * @param token - GitLab personal access token.
   * @param repo - Repository in 'owner/name' format.
   * @param apiUrl - GitLab API base URL (default: https://gitlab.com/api/v4).
   */

message: Multiple @returns tags across ~25 methods say 'Description.' instead of providing actual documentation about the return value — passes lint but offers zero value.
suggestion: Replace every 'Description.' with a meaningful description matching the style used in adapter.ts, e.g., 'Promise resolving to PR context.', 'Promise resolving to issue context.', 'Array of paginated items from all pages.'
suggestionCode: * @returns Array of paginated items from all pages.

message: Multiple @param descriptions follow the pattern 'X argument.' (e.g., 'number argument.', 'body argument.', 'labels argument.') — tautological stubs that convey nothing beyond the parameter name. Affects ~30+ @param tags across paginate, getMR, isMR, getIssue, listComments, postComment, and ~20 other methods.
suggestion: Replace all 'X argument.' descriptions with meaningful explanations, e.g., '@param number - Merge request number.' or '@param body - Comment body text.' Reference adapter.ts for style.
suggestionCode:
* @param number - Merge request number.
   * @param body - Comment body text.

message: One-line method descriptions ('Get MR.', 'Get issue.', etc.) are too terse. GitHub helper methods use full-sentence descriptions explaining behavior and context.
suggestion: Use full-sentence descriptions matching the GitHub helper style, e.g., 'Fetch a merge request's metadata and changed files, extracting linked issue numbers from the description.'

message: Inline JSDoc comment on an inner type alias (CompareResponse) inside getDiffSince — TypeScript type aliases at function scope do not need JSDoc.
suggestion: Remove the JSDoc comment above the CompareResponse type alias.
suggestionCode: type CompareResponse = { diffs: Array<{ diff: string }> };

message: JSDoc added to auto-generated .d.ts declaration files (fix.d.ts, self-heal.d.ts, post/fix.d.ts, post/self-heal.d.ts). These are build artifacts overwritten on every pnpm build — manual edits will be lost.
suggestion: Remove JSDoc from .d.ts files; keep JSDoc only in source .ts files under action/src/. Run pnpm build to regenerate correct declarations.

message: Missing blank line between the description and @param/@returns section in both JSDoc blocks. The rest of the codebase (retry.ts, logger.ts, circuit-breaker.ts) consistently separates description from tags with a blank line.
suggestion: Add a blank line between the description and the first JSDoc tag for consistency with codebase conventions.
